visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands with long manicured nails opens a complex white paper invitation suite on a light wood floor. (2) A woman with dark hair wearing a light blue t-shirt and grey pants sits at a white table, unfolding a heart-shaped paper construction. (3) The hands flip through a stack of high-quality photographic cards showing a couple in wedding attire near a horse-drawn carriage and a fountain. (4) A card labeled 'DRESS CODE' with five colored circles (Champagne, Rose Gold, Mauve, Leather, Taupe) is displayed against a white background. (5) The hands insert a three-frame photo strip into a vellum pocket and secure a 'SAVE THE DATE' card with a silver paperclip. (6) The person applies liquid glue to the edge of a grey paper sachet and presses it closed. (7) A large plastic bag filled with small mesh tea-like bags is shown; one is inserted into the grey sachet labeled 'ENDLESSLY BECOMING'. (8) The woman ties a thin black ribbon into a bow around the white invitation folder. (9) A close-up shows a gold square stamp pressing into melting cream-colored wax on a grey silicone mat, forming a logo seal.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: BLAIRE CHEN. [Slogan]: ENDLESSLY BECOMING EACH OTHER'S HOME. (2) [Subtitle]: DRESS CODE FORMAL ATTIRE REQUIRED. (3) [Subtitle]: COLOR PALETTE CHAMPAGNE ROSE GOLD MAUVE LEATHER TAUPE. (4) [Subtitle]: SAVE THE DATE 21 JUNE 2025. (5) [Subtitle]: to BE continued.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy acoustic guitar strumming begins with a strong rhythmic beat. (2) Rapid-fire foley sounds of paper rustling and crisp tearing occur in sync with quick visual cuts. (3) A sharp plastic rustle is heard as a bag is manipulated, followed by a metallic click from a paperclip. (4) The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat tempo with bright guitar transients. (5) A distinct wet sliding sound followed by a heavy, percussive thud as the wax seal is pressed down. (6) The audio ends abruptly with a final rhythmic beat.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Step-by-step Assembly -> Final Result.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the intricate DIY process of assembling custom wedding invitations, showcasing the attention to detail through tactile elements like photo strips, color palettes, and wax seals to generate excitement for an upcoming event.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses ASMR-style foley editing to emphasize the tactile quality of the stationary and invitation components.
